definitions.explanation: The ability to predict or anticipate future events or developments. Often used in the phrase {先見|せんけん}の{明|めい} (the wisdom of foresight).

examples.japanese: {先見|せんけん}の{明|めい}がある
その{投資家|とうしか}は{先見|せんけん}の{明|めい}があった。
{創業者|そうぎょうしゃ}の{先見|せんけん}の{明|めい}によって、{会社|かいしゃ}は{時代|じだい}の{変化|へんか}に{対応|たいおう}できた。
examples.english: Thanks to the founder's foresight, the company was able to adapt to the changing times.

notes:
USAGE: Almost always used in the fixed phrase {先見|せんけん}の{明|めい} (the wisdom of foresight). Rarely used alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先見|せんけん}の{明|めい} (foresight, prescience - the most common usage)
- {先見|せんけん}の{明|めい}がある/ない (to have/lack foresight)
- {先見|せんけん}{性|せい} (foresightedness)

RELATED WORDS:
- {予見|よけん} (prediction, foresight)
- {見通|みとお}し (outlook, prospect)
- {慧眼|けいがん} (discerning eye)
